item.title: Jungle
item.description: “Do you know why I chose the jungle?. I didn’t choose the jungle. The jungle is where I was born. A raw, hard and intense environment. Perfect place for a perfect accident. What could be more ideal? Beautiful and reluctant at the same time. A place that combines fire and mist, storm and sunsets. So much life, everywhere, every second, at your ears, at your shoulders, everywhere claiming what’s theirs.

item.title: Love goes on
item.description: There was a man who loved women so much that even Gaia couldn’t comprehend it. Thousands of lives lived and died under many names but only one soul. Insane. The most wild, brave and independent of them all, whose passion and intensity could only be matched by creation itself. Gaia was so wise, she always knew, that she was preparing the warrior for one more job. And the warrior what? Does he have a choice?
